title: A package graph: turfc --package-graph's input, and what turf graph prints
description: IF-2. The version is "format" (an integer, the schema's major version; turfc --version --json names the one it reads under schemas.package_graph). A key is added only with a driver interface minor that reads it ("tests": 1.3), because turfc rejects a package key it does not know; changing or removing a key is a new format. A relative path is relative to the graph file. turf build writes it without "tests"; turf test and turf graph add the root's "tests" when the project has one.

root.description: The package being built; a key of packages.

packages.description: Every package of the graph, keyed by its name, which is how `import` spells it.

deps.description: The packages it imports, each once; each must be in packages, and a library (its src/ holds <name>.tr).

allow_unsafe.description: Whether the package's `unsafe module;` files are honored (the root's [unsafe] allow decides it for a dependency). Absent means false.

tests.description: Since driver interface 1.3. The root package's tests/ directory; no other package has one.
